wallets.ddl:
CREATE TABLE wallets (
	dso_id UUID, 
	clinic_id UUID, 
	parent_wallet_id UUID, 
	wallet_type wallet_type_enum NOT NULL, 
	status wallet_status_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL, 
	external_wallet_username VARCHAR, 
	external_wallet_password_encrypted VARCHAR, 
	external_wallet_address VARCHAR, 
	currency VARCHAR DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL, 
	cached_balance_minor BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	auto_debit_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	last_balance_sync_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	kyc_verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	failure_reason VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_wallet_clinic_type UNIQUE (clinic_id, wallet_type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dso_id) REFERENCES "Dsos" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_wallet_id) REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_auto_debit_enabled ON wallets (auto_debit_enabled)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_clinic_id ON wallets (clinic_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_dso_id ON wallets (dso_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_external_wallet_address ON wallets (external_wallet_address)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_external_wallet_username ON wallets (external_wallet_username)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_kyc_verified ON wallets (kyc_verified)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_parent_wallet_id ON wallets (parent_wallet_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_status ON wallets (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_wallets_wallet_type ON wallets (wallet_type)
CREATE INDEX ix_walletss_dso_clinic_parent ON wallets (dso_id, clinic_id, parent_wallet_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_wallets_id ON wallets (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_wallet_dso_treasury ON wallets (dso_id) WHERE wallet_type = 'DSO_TREASURY'

role_assignments.ddl:
CREATE TABLE role_assignments (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	scope_type scope_type_enum NOT NULL, 
	role role_type_enum NOT NULL, 
	dso_id UUID, 
	clinic_id UUID, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(dso_id) REFERENCES "Dsos" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_role_assignments_user_scope_clinic_active ON role_assignments (user_id, scope_type, clinic_id, is_active)
CREATE INDEX ix_role_assignments_user_scope_dso_active ON role_assignments (user_id, scope_type, dso_id, is_active)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_role_assignments_id ON role_assignments (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_clinic_membership ON role_assignments (user_id, clinic_id) WHERE scope_type = 'CLINIC' AND is_active
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_dso_membership ON role_assignments (user_id, dso_id) WHERE scope_type = 'DSO' AND is_active

audit_logs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	clinic_id UUID, 
	entity_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	details JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_audit_logs_id ON audit_logs (id)

external_operations.ddl:
CREATE TABLE external_operations (
	operation_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	resource_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_encrypted TEXT, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	secrets_encrypted TEXT, 
	result_encrypted TEXT, 
	failure_code VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (operation_key)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_external_operations_resource_id ON external_operations (resource_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_external_operations_id ON external_operations (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_external_operation_active_resource ON external_operations (resource_id, action) WHERE state IN ('in_flight', 'uncertain', 'succeeded')

registered_clinics.ddl:
CREATE TABLE registered_clinics (
	crm_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	clinic_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	clinic_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	clinic_timezone VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	od_developer_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	od_customer_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	crm_api_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	webhook_secret VARCHAR, 
	location_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	calendar_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	operatory_calendar_map JSON, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	dso_id UUID, 
	last_webhook_auth_failed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	webhook_auth_failure_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	od_health_status VARCHAR, 
	od_health_reason VARCHAR, 
	od_health_changed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	sync_paused_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	crm_health_status VARCHAR, 
	crm_health_reason VARCHAR, 
	crm_health_changed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	is_disabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	disabled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	disabled_by UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(dso_id) REFERENCES "Dsos" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(disabled_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_registered_clinics_dso_id ON registered_clinics (dso_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_registered_clinics_is_disabled ON registered_clinics (is_disabled)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_registered_clinics_id ON registered_clinics (id)

inbound_events.ddl:
CREATE TABLE inbound_events (
	clinic_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	crm_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR, 
	contact_id VARCHAR, 
	job_id VARCHAR, 
	processing_status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	failure_reason VARCHAR, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	sync_log_id UUID, 
	next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	alert_id UUID, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(alert_id) REFERENCES sync_alerts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_inbound_events_clinic_received_at ON inbound_events (clinic_id, received_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_inbound_events_waiting ON inbound_events (clinic_id, received_at) WHERE processing_status IN ('queued', 'waiting', 'retrying', 'needs_attention', 'processing')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_inbound_events_id ON inbound_events (id)

appointments.ddl:
CREATE TABLE appointments (
	"AptNum" INTEGER, 
	event_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	previous_status VARCHAR, 
	status_changed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	start_time VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	end_time VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	date VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	calendar_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	commslog_done BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	popups_done BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	last_event_received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	note_hash VARCHAR, 
	clinic_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pat_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT "uq_clinic_AptNum" UNIQUE (clinic_id, "AptNum"), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_clinic_eventid UNIQUE (clinic_id, event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(pat_id) REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_appointments_id ON appointments (id)

sync_alerts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sync_alerts (
	clinic_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	audience VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subject_key VARCHAR DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	emailed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	email_error VARCHAR, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_sync_alerts_id ON sync_alerts (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_sync_alerts_open ON sync_alerts (clinic_id, code, subject_key) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

user_notifications.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_notifications (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	alert_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	read_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_user_notification_alert UNIQUE (user_id, alert_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(alert_id) REFERENCES sync_alerts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_user_notifications_user_created ON user_notifications (user_id, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_user_notifications_id ON user_notifications (id)
